description: v5 RED lava goo, still a bit see-through (artist 2026-09-26 cross-unit round: 'make him more red overall than the solid orange he has right now, the accent colors are fine' -> design/reference/magmoo-v5-rest-pose-reference.png: a glossy red lava body, hue ~2 deg as rendered, with orange flow patches and yellow drops/tips). v5 moves ONLY the body goo (goo, goo_cool) from the v4 orange (hue 25 deg) to red, and darkens the socket to match the new body; the accents (goo_hot flow patches + ridges, flame tips, white-hot cores + droplets) are the v4 values unchanged. The whole body is molten, so every goo region glows; the glow tiers still grade heat across the goo: deep crimson undersides, red body, yellow-orange flow patches and ridges, yellow flame tips (crown points, torn-end tufts, head flame licks, drips, the ball's ears, the goo bridges + shed drips), pale-yellow white-hot core at every torn end (the join faces) and on the droplets. EYES: 'eye' is the carved socket interior (a darker shade of the body red, no glow); v5 'eye_goo' is the solid RED GOO EYE filling each socket (artist: 'put a red goo eye no pupil just one solid piece where its carved out'): deep crimson, no glow (emission well under the coolest goo), near-opaque so it reads as one flat solid piece against the glowing see-through body. 'alpha' (0-1, Col alpha = glTF COLOR_0.a) keeps the see-through goo at the v4 values; material.alpha multiplies every region (one knob for 'more / less see-through').

goo_cool.note: undersides (smoothed normal pointing down): deep crimson goo (v4 [196, 62, 12] orange-red)

goo.note: the body: glossy RED lava slime (the v5 reference body; v4 [242, 112, 20] orange)

goo_hot.note: ACCENT, v4 unchanged: hotter yellow-orange flow patches (smooth mottling) + ridges

flame.note: ACCENT, v4 unchanged: flame tips: head flame licks, crown points, torn-end tufts, drip bulbs, finger tips, the ball's ears, the goo bridges + shed drips; the ring round each torn end

core.note: ACCENT, v4 unchanged: white-hot molten core: the torn (join) end faces, the crater, the droplets

eye.note: the carved eye socket (now mostly filled by the goo eye; its lip shows as a thin dark ring) - a darker shade of the body red, no glow

eye_goo.note: v5.1: the solid red goo eye filling each socket - one piece, no pupil, no white; INNER GLOW (artist 2026-09-26): lit from within, tier between the body goo (0.30) and the hot accents (0.55)

eye_core.note: v5.3 (artist: 'needs something inside to show it reads more as an eye'): the molten inner disc of each eye - hotter than the eye ring, still under the goo_hot accents
